fixedCLI.lockNote: Canonical P0 lock with the libreoffice-kit fflate 0.8.3 security override (docs/dependency-security.md); the acceptance script hashes it at run time and checks the dsh integrity and the override. The P0 recording keeps the pre-override historical lockSha256 479e917f…c2.

boundaries: No real API key or external model service used.
The default environment preparer intentionally fails explicitly until P2 is wired in P3b; this driver does not duplicate credentials/configuration preparation.
Existing runtime ids are retained and recovery currently fails explicitly; P3b implements resume/restart/cancel/lease race semantics.
Reverse permission requests return cancelled until the P4 permission/MCP bridge is connected; no permissive fallback.
Ordinary Go tests use fake processes. The fixed CLI scenario is opt-in via dsh_integration and mandatory in the acceptance script.
Only Linux amd64/Node26 was reproduced; other platforms and production deployment remain outside this task.
